hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -n "$file" ]; then case "$file" in *.py) black --quiet "$file" 2>/dev/null || true ;; *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx) npx prettier --write "$file" 2>/dev/null || true ;; esac; fi

cmd="$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND"; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(rm\s+-rf\s+/[^a-z]|DROP\s+DATABASE|TRUNCATE\s+TABLE|--no-preserve-root)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Destructive command detected' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
